Excellent. Now I have all the info needed. Let me compile the comprehensive bug list.

## AUDIT REPORT: Blog Page Implementation vs Webflow

**CRITICAL BUGS:**

1. **blog-card.module.css:63-64** — `.body` uses `align-content: center; place-items: center start;` causing vertical centering mismatch. The Webflow `.blog-card` uses `flex-direction: column` (no centering). Expected: remove `align-content: center; place-items: center start;` or use `align-items: start;` only → breaks vertical space distribution, description gets crushed.

2. **blog-card.module.css:19-20** — `.card` height set to `240px` but Webflow `.blog-card` is flex column with `grid-row-gap: 24px`. Image + body content can't fit in 240px. Expected: remove fixed height or use `min-height: auto; height: auto;` → image gets clipped, text overflows.

3. **blog-detail-view.tsx:57** — `.catName` displays `post.shortDescription` but semantic HTML says this is a subtitle (description). Webflow detail page uses separate `.blog-detail-cat-name` for category. Expected: verify this is intentional (not a misnamed usage) → misleading DOM structure.

4. **src/lib/constants/blog.ts:1-85** — All 6 posts share identical `SHARED_CONTENT` (Lorem ipsum). Webflow CSV has unique HTML content per post. Expected: map real content from CSV column 13 → every detail page shows identical placeholder text.

**DATA BUGS:**

5. **src/lib/constants/blog.ts:27-28, 38-39, 49-50, 60-61, 71-72** — All posts use hardcoded `publishedAt: "2026-04-08T12:54:29Z"` and no `updatedAt`. Webflow CSV shows different "Published On" dates per post. Expected: extract unique timestamps from CSV Published On column → all posts show same publication date, breaks chronological sorting.

6. **src/lib/constants/blog.ts** — Missing all `updatedAt` values while type allows optional. CSV has "Updated On" column. Expected: populate from CSV Updated On (row 9) → modifiedTime schema field always falls back to publishedAt, SEO benefit lost.

7. **src/app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx:29-30** — Uses `post.updatedAt ?? post.publishedAt` for modifiedTime but no post in constants has updatedAt → always uses publishedAt. Expected: add updatedAt to at least some posts → dateModified in schema.org always equals datePublished.

**UI/CSS DEVIATIONS vs Webflow:**

8. **blog-card.module.css:8-9** — `.card` has `grid-column-gap: 1rem; grid-row-gap: 1rem;` but `.body` has `grid-column-gap: 0.3rem; grid-row-gap: 0.3rem;` (10x smaller). Webflow uses consistent spacing. Expected: align to single gap value (likely 1rem for body) → inconsistent internal card spacing.

9. **blog-card.module.css:56-68** — `.body` is a grid with 2 rows but only renders header (1 item) + description + button as 3 flex children. Grid layout mismatch. Expected: simplify to `display: flex; flex-direction: column;` → grid row/col gap properties don't work as intended.

10. **blog-hero.module.css:123-151** — Unused `.cta` class (styled button) but component uses `<Button>` component instead. Expected: remove dead CSS or unify styling → dead code, confusion over button styling source.

**INTERACTIVITY BUGS:**

11. **blog-grid.tsx:86-87** — Category checkbox toggle: `setActiveCategory(isActive ? "all" : cat.slug)` uses ternary but the "Clear" button calls same handler. Clicking an active category unsets it (good), but Clear button is redundant. Expected: consolidate or document intent → UX ambiguity.

12. **blog-grid.tsx:122** — Image link has `tabIndex={-1} aria-hidden="true"` because title link below it is focusable. But card is an `<article>` wrapping both. Expected: use single link per card (image + title) to avoid keyboard trap → screen readers ignore image, keyboard users only focus title link (correct but hidden semantics).

**RESPONSIVE DEVIATIONS:**

13. **blog-card.module.css:157-162 (@media min-width: 1280px)** — Sets `height: 270px; min-height: 280px;` (conflicting: max is 270, min is 280). Webflow doesn't specify. Expected: use `height: auto; min-height: 270px;` → CSS logic broken at 1280px+ breakpoint.

14. **blog-grid.module.css:28-35** — `.filterGrid` defaults to `0.4fr 1fr` (sidebar narrower) but CSS comment says `.4fr 1fr`. At 991px breakpoint (line 316) it becomes `0.35fr 1fr` (even narrower). No mobile-first logic. Expected: define single ratio and scale down responsively → sidebar grows at larger screens when it should stay consistent.

**MISSING FIELDS / TYPE ISSUES:**

15. **src/types/blog.ts** — Type allows `updatedAt?: string; content?: string;` as optional but detail page assumes `content` exists (line 73). Expected: either make content required or add fallback in template → dangerouslySetInnerHTML may render undefined.

16. **blog-grid.tsx:9-17** — `CATEGORY_LABELS` includes all 6 categories but `BLOG_CATEGORIES` includes "all" which isn't a real category. Expected: remove "all" from BLOG_CATEGORIES or filter it in the map — the checkbox list shouldn't show "All" as a clickable option (it's shown in Clear button).

**SEO/META BUGS:**

17. **[slug]/page.tsx:29, 87** — Schema.org BlogPosting uses `logo` URL hardcoded (line 89) instead of `SITE_CONFIG.logo`. Webflow references same image. Expected: use consistent SITE_CONFIG value → logo URL may drift from site branding.

18. **blog-card.tsx:40** — Image alt text is `${post.title} cover` but no post title exists when card is rendering grid, title in Link is redundant. Expected: move alt to image only (no title duplication in alt) → alt text is verbose for screen readers.

---

**Summary:** 18 bugs spanning data hardcoding (identical posts, timestamps), layout conflicts (grid/flex mixing, height constraints), CSS dead code, unimplemented fields, and responsive breakpoint errors. Highest priority: fix blog content data (bug #4), card height (bug #2), body alignment (bug #1).

## AUDIT REPORT: Blog Page Implementation vs Webflow

**CRITICAL BUGS:**

1. **blog-card.module.css:63-64** — `.body` uses `align-content: center; place-items: center start;` causing vertical centering mismatch. The Webflow `.blog-card` uses `flex-direction: column` (no centering). Expected: remove `align-content: center; place-items: center start;` or use `align-items: start;` only → breaks vertical space distribution, description gets crushed.

2. **blog-card.module.css:19-20** — `.card` height set to `240px` but Webflow `.blog-card` is flex column with `grid-row-gap: 24px`. Image + body content can't fit in 240px. Expected: remove fixed height or use `min-height: auto; height: auto;` → image gets clipped, text overflows.

3. **blog-detail-view.tsx:57** — `.catName` displays `post.shortDescription` but semantic HTML says this is a subtitle (description). Webflow detail page uses separate `.blog-detail-cat-name` for category. Expected: verify this is intentional (not a misnamed usage) → misleading DOM structure.

4. **src/lib/constants/blog.ts:1-85** — All 6 posts share identical `SHARED_CONTENT` (Lorem ipsum). Webflow CSV has unique HTML content per post. Expected: map real content from CSV column 13 → every detail page shows identical placeholder text.

**DATA BUGS:**

5. **src/lib/constants/blog.ts:27-28, 38-39, 49-50, 60-61, 71-72** — All posts use hardcoded `publishedAt: "2026-04-08T12:54:29Z"` and no `updatedAt`. Webflow CSV shows different "Published On" dates per post. Expected: extract unique timestamps from CSV Published On column → all posts show same publication date, breaks chronological sorting.

6. **src/lib/constants/blog.ts** — Missing all `updatedAt` values while type allows optional. CSV has "Updated On" column. Expected: populate from CSV Updated On (row 9) → modifiedTime schema field always falls back to publishedAt, SEO benefit lost.

7. **src/app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx:29-30** — Uses `post.updatedAt ?? post.publishedAt` for modifiedTime but no post in constants has updatedAt → always uses publishedAt. Expected: add updatedAt to at least some posts → dateModified in schema.org always equals datePublished.

**UI/CSS DEVIATIONS vs Webflow:**

8. **blog-card.module.css:8-9** — `.card` has `grid-column-gap: 1rem; grid-row-gap: 1rem;` but `.body` has `grid-column-gap: 0.3rem; grid-row-gap: 0.3rem;` (10x smaller). Webflow uses consistent spacing. Expected: align to single gap value (likely 1rem for body) → inconsistent internal card spacing.

9. **blog-card.module.css:56-68** — `.body` is a grid with 2 rows but only renders header (1 item) + description + button as 3 flex children. Grid layout mismatch. Expected: simplify to `display: flex; flex-direction: column;` → grid row/col gap properties don't work as intended.

10. **blog-hero.module.css:123-151** — Unused `.cta` class (styled button) but component uses `<Button>` component instead. Expected: remove dead CSS or unify styling → dead code, confusion over button styling source.

**INTERACTIVITY BUGS:**

11. **blog-grid.tsx:86-87** — Category checkbox toggle: `setActiveCategory(isActive ? "all" : cat.slug)` uses ternary but the "Clear" button calls same handler. Clicking an active category unsets it (good), but Clear button is redundant. Expected: consolidate or document intent → UX ambiguity.

12. **blog-grid.tsx:122** — Image link has `tabIndex={-1} aria-hidden="true"` because title link below it is focusable. But card is an `<article>` wrapping both. Expected: use single link per card (image + title) to avoid keyboard trap → screen readers ignore image, keyboard users only focus title link (correct but hidden semantics).

**RESPONSIVE DEVIATIONS:**

13. **blog-card.module.css:157-162 (@media min-width: 1280px)** — Sets `height: 270px; min-height: 280px;` (conflicting: max is 270, min is 280). Webflow doesn't specify. Expected: use `height: auto; min-height: 270px;` → CSS logic broken at 1280px+ breakpoint.

14. **blog-grid.module.css:28-35** — `.filterGrid` defaults to `0.4fr 1fr` (sidebar narrower) but CSS comment says `.4fr 1fr`. At 991px breakpoint (line 316) it becomes `0.35fr 1fr` (even narrower). No mobile-first logic. Expected: define single ratio and scale down responsively → sidebar grows at larger screens when it should stay consistent.

**MISSING FIELDS / TYPE ISSUES:**

15. **src/types/blog.ts** — Type allows `updatedAt?: string; content?: string;` as optional but detail page assumes `content` exists (line 73). Expected: either make content required or add fallback in template → dangerouslySetInnerHTML may render undefined.

16. **blog-grid.tsx:9-17** — `CATEGORY_LABELS` includes all 6 categories but `BLOG_CATEGORIES` includes "all" which isn't a real category. Expected: remove "all" from BLOG_CATEGORIES or filter it in the map — the checkbox list shouldn't show "All" as a clickable option (it's shown in Clear button).

**SEO/META BUGS:**

17. **[slug]/page.tsx:29, 87** — Schema.org BlogPosting uses `logo` URL hardcoded (line 89) instead of `SITE_CONFIG.logo`. Webflow references same image. Expected: use consistent SITE_CONFIG value → logo URL may drift from site branding.

18. **blog-card.tsx:40** — Image alt text is `${post.title} cover` but no post title exists when card is rendering grid, title in Link is redundant. Expected: move alt to image only (no title duplication in alt) → alt text is verbose for screen readers.

---

**Summary:** 18 bugs spanning data hardcoding (identical posts, timestamps), layout conflicts (grid/flex mixing, height constraints), CSS dead code, unimplemented fields, and responsive breakpoint errors. Highest priority: fix blog content data (bug #4), card height (bug #2), body alignment (bug #1).

Related grid 3-col @ ≥992px, 2-col @ 768-991, 1-col below.
